forbidden_inferences: source admission or archive depth -> public program, distribution route, reuse licence, external authority, price quote, or purchase authority
foreign twin cache -> remote authority
observe right -> bind or act right
retained body -> verified availability
weak public supply signal -> exact availability fact
policy exclusion -> absence of external inventory
a 304 -> the thing not having changed in the world; it says the representation this estate holds is still current
a completed sweep -> permission to republish anything it read
a boundary response -> a source that does not exist; it is what the transport said at that moment
policy_excluded -> a source refusing this estate specifically; robots is a standing rule the source wrote for everyone
an RFC 9421 message signature verifying -> factual correctness or reuse permission; it is communication authenticity
a superseded observation -> a deleted one (it remains recorded and readable through history)
a listed conflict -> a source that lied (content changing is ordinary; the institution only has to know its earlier belief is no longer current)
a promoted twin -> a claimed, verified or owned one
a claim -> a verified relationship (AssertionBoundary and Authority decide what it is worth)
an admissible receipt -> a true or useful claim (it says the read was authorized, and nothing about what the bytes say)
a registered twin -> an active, present, or partnered one
a classified kind -> a verified one (someone asserted this is a property source, and that is an assertion like any other)
a bound body -> an admitted fact or a licence to redistribute it
a resolvable closure -> a reachable subject
a derived field -> a new observation (it is one arrangement of the rows it was computed from, and it is stale the moment they change)
a field cell -> a fact about the world (a source observed twice as often is not twice as real)
a regime -> a licence (retaining bytes because a regime permits it does not make retention lawful)
a promoted source -> a claimed, licensed or authorized one
a public promotion path -> a safe one for every observation (the closure an observation belongs to is a property of where its receipt lives, not of the command that reads it)
internal_calculi: a receipt carries two independent sets of facts about one representation: this estate's digest of the bytes it retained, and the source's own statements about what it served -- ETag, Last-Modified, Content-Type, Content-Location, Link rel=license and rel=canonical, RFC 9530 Content-Digest and Repr-Digest, and whether an RFC 9421 message signature was present. Keeping only the first loses the only machine-readable statement of rights a source ever makes

re-observation is conditional whenever a prior receipt carries a validator. Receipts append, so the newest line is the one read for it; a 304 becomes a new observation at a new knowledge time that references the prior body rather than retaining a second copy of it
invariants: a retained body is found under the foreign root this estate is told to use, by the name its receipt gave it, and never outside that directory: a receipt records where a reading happened, not where the estate keeps its evidence now, and an estate that can only read its own bodies from the absolute path they were first written to cannot be moved, restored, or carried onto another machine

every native Project foreign verb derives missing receipt and body directories from BONFYRE_FOREIGN_ROOT; explicit leaf-directory settings retain precedence and an overlong derived path refuses without falling back to another store
a cached projection is not remote truth
a retained observation body is parsed only while it still hashes to its receipt
a retained observation body path is immutable after receipt materialization

a private institutional or self ForeignTwin observation retains its body and receipt below its closure-derived estate/scope or actor root; the public foreign carrier and a sibling institutional or actor closure cannot enumerate it

a self ForeignTwin workspace enumerates and inspects only receipt filenames derived below the current authenticated actor root, rehashes a selected retained body against its receipt before showing an excerpt, and never accepts a body path, actor root, or public ForeignTwin coordinate from the browser
a projected candidate carries the receipt digest of the body it was read from

a retained-body exact query answers only whether ForeignTwin currently has a receipt for that exact subject and predicate; it remains separate from body rehash, semantic relevance, and every admission decision
a housing AvailabilityCandidate requires a current public observe right, allow decision, attempted fetch, and successful robots preflight on its ForeignTwin receipt
a source excluded by robots or an absent observe right is receipted without fetching its source URL

a bounded byte-range observation preflights robots and observe right before fetching, caps the received body, records sample_observed rather than a full source observation, and never promotes partial bytes as a complete foreign identity

a bounded full-response observation caps the received body without requesting a byte range, refuses redirects because a robots check cannot silently move to another host, and emits source_observed only for a complete successful response; transient design-anatomy bytes may be released after receipt-bound measurement without claiming current availability

the product release projection joins published source contracts to SourceFrontier's authored exact_address (using legacy address only when the ledger has no exact_address column), then joins ItemArchive and observed-price reductions by exact authored source coordinate through bounded indexes; it carries separately authored spatial, media, rights and publisher extraction declarations, and reads distinct SiteProgram identities only through its authored source_collection source_refs bridge: collection fanout is not multiple programs, and program input is never a rendered route or verified delivery

a cross-domain readiness path is only an independently-owned input closure for a later compiler: a declared extractor plus retained archive material is ready_for_extraction and not an extracted spatial/media/rights fact; publisher remains a declared identifier; economics reaches observed only through exact authored source-coordinate price binding; each missing path names its blocked binding

a ForeignTwin page is a bounded carrier slice while release_summary is calculated over the entire owner closure; offset/limit affects only which rich rows cross the carrier, never the reported estate census, readiness totals, economics totals or public-program input totals

a ForeignTwin query is a bounded case-insensitive literal filter over authored source-contract fields (URL, source identity, family, carries, or declared publisher); it returns result total and estate_total separately, never claims semantic relevance, ownership, classification, or a changed whole-estate readiness frontier

every bounded source-release page is deterministically ordered and carries a locally-derived catalogue_generation over its exact owner projection; a later page that names a different expected generation is refused as snapshot_mismatch rather than silently combining two working-set releases. This generation states only local projection continuity, never remote-world immutability or the cause of a change

price observations join a ForeignTwin only through an exact authored source coordinate; an unmatched economic source identity stays visible as unbound rather than being guessed from publisher wording, hostname similarity, item title, or family

a source-supplied digest is held apart from this estate's own and neither is promoted to the other; ours proves the bytes have not drifted since retention and the source's is what the publisher asserted about what it served
robots permitting a read is not a licence to republish; Link rel=license is a separate fact, it is usually absent, and absent means the source stated none rather than that permission exists

a validator is handed back to a source exactly as the source issued it; an ETag contains quotes and a parser that stops at the first one returns a mangled validator that every source ignores, which makes conditional re-observation appear to work while never having worked
an observation is never overwritten: a 404 at one time and retained bytes at another are two records, and the relation between them is computed rather than resolved by keeping only the newer

current content and current availability are separate answers; the most recent observation that retained bytes and the most recent observation of any kind are different questions, and reporting one as both hides bytes held from a source that no longer serves them
a resource that never retained content reports null reachability, not false; false would claim the content held is unreachable about content that was never held

observation, promotion and claim are three standings and none is ownership: observing records that something answered, promoting means the institution chose to be able to name it, and claiming is an assertion by some institution

a twin is promoted only when an observation actually retained bytes; its identity digest is the content digest that was retained and its evidence_ref names the receipt that retained it, so an identity whose digest was invented cannot exist
a twin's identity derives from the address it was observed at, not from a receipt filename that changes every observation
a promoted twin carries an address and a presence, and its presence is LIVE: an observation of the real world stays real even when a demo institution is the one looking
two subjects sharing an identity digest are reported rather than merged; which id is canonical is not the storage layer's call, and collapsing them would strand whatever already references the loser

an observation that retains content promotes its resource in the same act; the one moment an identity is unambiguous is when the bytes that identify it are in hand, and deferring it invites an identity derived later by a different rule beside the one derived here
a failed promotion does not fail the observation; the receipt is written and the bytes are kept, so a resource that could not be named stays observable

promotion refuses a private closure: an observation under an estate or actor root belongs to whoever took it, and publishing one as a public subject would make it readable by everything that can read the Matrix. A caller that means to promote privately must say so and say into which scope

an identity is derived only from a body that still hashes to its receipt; a drifted body is no longer the thing the receipt describes, and an identity taken from it would be attested by a receipt for different content

the estate observes two shapes of external thing and they do not identify the same way: a URL twin is one resource fetched repeatedly, identified by the bytes it last returned; a source is an endpoint observed across many pages, identified by a digest over its sorted distinct page digests

a source twin carries no web address, because the estate holds no route to it; binding an invented URL would assert a route that cannot resolve, which is worse than having none. A presence is still bound, because the source is a real thing observed in the live world
a source identity moves when what the source serves moves and not otherwise; an identity that drifted on re-observation would make every source a new thing each time it was looked at

a claim derived from an observation requires the read to have been authorized under the policy recorded at the time: public observe right, allow decision, attempted fetch, and a successful robots preflight where a 404 counts as success. A body digest proves what a parser read and never that it was permitted to
the admission law is not housing-shaped; any derived claim needs the same five facts, and holding it in one domain's normalizer made it unaskable by anything else

registration and activation are different acts: registering establishes that a stable foreign identity exists, and binds no presence. Observing something does not make it present in this institution's world, or a partner, provider, opportunity or offer
activation and deactivation are authority-gated in both directions; turning a subject on or off in the world is an act, not a side effect of having looked at it

not every twin is mirrored: a hydration regime is authored per twin from MIRROR-LIKE, INDEXED, REMOTE and EPHEMERAL, and a twin with no authored regime is reported as unpoliced rather than defaulted, because an unmade decision is not a decision to mirror
cooling removes bodies a regime says not to keep and never removes a receipt; it reduces what is held, never what is known to have been seen
a regime is enforced where the body is written, not only by a later sweep; a cleanup is undone by the next observation, so a decision not to retain survived exactly until someone looked again
a twin with no authored regime retains its body; an unmade decision must not silently start discarding evidence, so the safe direction is to keep

a twin's applicable actions derive from what it is, not from the fact that it is foreign: subject kind ForeignTwin says only that authority is elsewhere, and investigating ownership is meaningless for a specification as mapping a vocabulary is for a tax roll
a twin's kind is authored rather than inferred from its address; guessing a kind from a hostname is how a merchant becomes a dataset
a kind nobody has declared actions for affords nothing rather than falling back to a generic set; an empty aperture list is an honest answer and a borrowed one is not

the columnar observation estate is a material-plane closure contribution, not a file the estate happens to query; a subject whose closure omits the bytes backing it describes an identity and not a thing

a Parquet row is not an admitted Matrix fact, a subject_candidate is not a MatrixSubject, and an observation row is not a RelationshipGraph edge; the columnar estate is a compressed factual representation and AssertionBoundary still controls admission
a columnar body that is a directory of parts is identified by a manifest digest over its sorted members; digesting one member would describe part of the body as though it were all of it
a closure resource is portable: a filesystem path is a reference only one host can follow, so contributions carry bonfyre://, https:// or urn: and never a local path

a closure can be taken over any subject with an active presence, not only one a hostname resolves to; closures addressed by host alone silently limited the manifest to institutions, and an observation source has no route at all

the closure manifest carries each plane's contributions with owner, representation, resource and exact digest, in both the crate and the field carrier; a manifest that says references are listed below and lists none is worse than one that says the plane is sparse

Parquet and Zarr compose rather than compete: the columnar body holds durable observation facts and the field holds their chunked arrangement, and lowering one into the other is an ordinary derivation

a derived field carries its lineage in its own attributes -- the exact digest of the body it was lowered from, the derivation that produced it, and the observation frontier at that moment -- so a cell is traceable to the rows, sources and owners it counts
a field reconciles with the corpus it came from; a grid whose total does not match the observations it aggregates is describing something else

an absent body and a changed body are different facts: a body present and hashing differently is drift and refuses promotion, while a body cooled under its regime promotes on the receipt digest that still identifies it

public foreign-body cooling indexes receipts once, requires a published retain_body=0 regime and a direct regular file inside the public bodies root, then refuses the entire apply plan if any receipt or candidate is unsafe; receipts are never removed

the Parquet-to-Zarr lowering uses the native query organ and streams exact source-body hashes; it stages the complete field before replacing only an owned Zarr output, and a failed query never publishes an empty field

columnar lowering and closure binding consume the same streamed body-identity law; binding refuses a derived field whose source digest, derivation frontier, shape or exact chunk length disagrees before any contribution is written
observed source promotion registers the digest of its sorted distinct page digests without binding presence or inventing a URL; query failure refuses rather than masquerading as an empty corpus
known_gaps: 307 of 400 sources could not have robots preflighted, so they were not read. That is the law working and it is also the dominant outcome: most of this estate cannot currently be observed at all, and whether that is unreachable hosts, redirect chains or WAFs is not yet separated.
the sweep is driven by hand and nothing schedules it. A plan is compiled, a bounded slice is observed, and no timer widens it; the estate moves when someone runs it.

no source in the observed slice stated a machine-readable licence. Link rel=license was absent on every one, so every rights question in the estate still rests on a human reading terms, which is a fact about how the web publishes rights rather than about this observer.

foreign observe now preflights a declared public observe right and robots.txt, preserving policy_excluded separately from a target boundary_response, and retains an allowed body under --body so a downstream reader can bind to exact receipted bytes. Retained Craigslist, Sublet.com property-card, and direct AppFolio public portal bodies now project only provenance-bound candidates; source-bound housing frontiers preserve direct, legacy-social, conditional-economics, feature-claim, and public-map proximity tiers rather than scoring unknown facts together. Geographic mapping retains Nominatim/Overpass source response digests and performs geodesic proximity plus park-first reverse discovery, without inferring a walk route, entrance distance, unit-specific exterior right, pet acceptance, or availability. A candidate is still not verified availability because verification would need a forbidden contact effect. The retained Sublet Dallas response currently lacks the required policy-preflight facts and visibly serves non-Dallas cards, so it remains non-promotable until a compliant Dallas observation exists. Other retained direct-source shapes remain unparsed.

130 presences were bound by registration before the two acts were separated, and withdrawing them needs an authority grant no current actor holds; the law prevents further ones and the backlog stays visible rather than being forced

forbidden_inferences: a reheated source -> a fresh fact; the receipt says when it was read, not that what it says is true
a declared family -> a source this estate can reach
an access label -> permission; a label says what kind of thing the source offers, never that this estate may take it
a retained body -> redistribution rights
internal_calculi: two hundred and twenty two rows: two hundred families declared and deliberately unwalked, eighteen concrete sources observed on a schedule, four refused and frozen. Each observed row carries an extraction contract -- which path holds the items, which field is the title, which field is the number -- so a surface reads a source it has never heard of without knowing its shape. Reheating is scheduled by ResourceWeather: the source's own cadence, multiplied by a tier, promoted by pack demand, demoted by silence, frozen by a refusal.
invariants: the census is a map and not a walk; most of it is declared and unobserved on purpose, and an estate that has observed most of its own census is mirroring the internet slowly
the extraction contract lives on the row rather than in a page; eighteen source shapes compiled into a landing page is the branch-per-product shape one layer up
the timer is a heartbeat and the cadence is in the data; a source with a six-hour cadence is asked every six hours however often the timer wakes
a refusal freezes rather than being retried; robots_disallow is an answer, and asking again every five minutes is not persistence
a source no activated pack's demand names falls a tier each time it is passed over, and stops being read at all
a receipt file is a history, one observation per line; reading it from the start answers with the first time a source was ever seen, which is the wrong body the moment anything is reheated
the scheduler is the organ that already owns the store, not a script beside it; two programs with two ideas of what a receipt looks like is one of them being wrong quietly
the scheduler writes nothing back to the census: the row is authored intent -- the url, the cadence, the contract -- and when a source was last read is a fact already in its own receipt
the tier is derived each run rather than stored; the authored tier is a floor, the last observation is the standing, and an activated pack's demand promotes
a says line is written in words a stranger knows, because the census is what the landing page speaks with

a media source carries where the picture is, how to get out to it and who made it; a wall that knows PeerTube calls it thumbnailPath and Lemmy calls it thumbnail_url is a wall with the outside world compiled into it
a relative thumbnail resolves against the host that made it, not the host that answered; a federated search returns video from many instances and one fixed origin breaks every one of them
a picture that will not load is removed rather than left as a placeholder; a grey rectangle sitting on a readable caption is worse than the caption alone
things you can look at come before columns of words; a trending tag is a word about the visible world and a thumbnail is the visible world
known_gaps: the two hundred families are names and labels; none carries a concrete endpoint, so a pack asking for one of them has nothing to bind to yet
demand promotion matches on words, so a family called "attention" is not matched by a pack demanding "Recipe" even when the recipe world is exactly what that attention source would serve
the media is a thumbnail and a link out, never an embedded player; nothing here streams, and the video is watched at the instance that holds it

only the fediverse answers with pictures and no key -- PeerTube, Lemmy, NASA. The platforms that hold most of the visible social world are in the census as families and need partner access this estate does not have

WebSub subscription and coalesced SourceDirty drain are native and receipt-bound; firehose and general webhook families remain unbound, and no candidate census row is subscribed merely because it advertises push

the reheat still runs from a systemd timer rather than from the organ's own loop, so the estate depends on the host's scheduler to breathe; the decision of what to read is native and the heartbeat is not

forbidden_inferences: a surface renders an action -> the action is authorized (Authority gates at effect time; the surface only shows affordances)
a fact is off-surface -> the fact does not exist (a surface is a projection, not the fabric)
a pasted public address -> fetched evidence, a ForeignTwin, canonical truth, or authority over the foreign system
a rendered CMS save result -> publication, public readability, or authority outside the selected content lifecycle
a fragment endpoint answering -> the pages that should use it rendering it

a declared lens or aperture -> a working or permitted one (a lens names a pattern that still enforces its own authority, and an aperture is offered only where the grammar applies and the actor is admitted)
a smaller extent -> a lesser subject (the same closure is addressed at every extent)
a green surface test -> a working surface (the extent asked for decides what is rendered, and a test that asks for the extent that works proves only that one)

a handler that never answers in production -> dead code (the a2a suite runs this organ with no CMS at all, which is the only condition under which the compiled floor answers, and the only reason the deletion was caught)
a fast server -> a fast page (every panel on an authored surface arrives as a later fragment, so the page is as slow as the runtime those fragments wait on)
a linked machine representation -> an authorized one (the manifest says where a representation is, never who may act on it)
a speculated path -> a visited one
a pattern listed in the catalogue -> a pattern this caller may read (the catalogue reports the requirement; the pattern still enforces it)
an entry existing in an authored type -> that entry being publicly served (publication state and row visibility both gate before a surface renders it)
a pattern descriptor exists -> the pattern is served (a descriptor naming a type the store does not carry yields an empty fragment and the page keeps its compiled fallback)
a compiled fallback rendering -> the authored content agreeing with it (a fallback is a resilience path, never cached truth)
internal_calculi: subject-first aperture: HTMX requests native, host-checked HTML fragments. Browser forms use the same typed Studio owner contracts as JSON carriers, and the server compiles owner receipts into readable result grammar. Content Home reads the canonical CMS tables for usable page/learning/application work rather than exposing schemas as the human entry point; a selected public URL remains only proposed route context until the authenticated ForeignTwin observe effect runs.
invariants: SurfaceRuntime keeps Actual (the exact derived Scene revision), Possible (declared lenses and apertures), Presence (actor scope plus transient interaction posture) and Material (declared owner-query plan) as separate planes; none is an identity, authority, availability, proof, commitment or effect claim

a SurfaceDelta applies only from its exact prior Scene digest; a changed digest carries a complete successor Scene, while an offline or mismatched client asks its owner-side carrier to reconcile and never applies a queued or partial owner result
a landing-page public-address handoff is only user-proposed route context; the native ForeignTwin observer still requires an explicit signed-in observe effect
a human Studio request receives a server-rendered result fragment rather than a raw JSON receipt; machine carriers retain their explicit JSON contract
a human CMS write submits ordinary form fields through the native content type, while the CMS alone compiles and validates its typed stored representation

a surface pattern is a CMS descriptor naming what it reads, its effect class and the authority it requires; the organ holds the render primitives, so a content write can add a surface but never introduce markup

a pattern's human and machine projections are compiled from one descriptor and one query; the same records in the same order reach HTMX and JSON, because there is one implementation rather than two carriers of one capability

the carrier symmetry holds at the error boundary too: an unauthenticated machine receives the refusal in its own grammar, because an auth gate that hands machines an HTML page breaks the same-capability claim exactly where every unauthenticated caller meets it

a declared API surface answers for its own errors and is never routed onward as an unbound address; a 404 fallthrough is right for a bare semantic path and wrong for an organ that already said something precise

a territory projection selects fields from one shared content type rather than owning a copy of the subjects; four territories reading one type with four field sets is the projection claim, and four types with similar rows would be its refutation

every page a person opens reads the authored navigation, whether the organ renders it server-side or the page swaps it in; a nav fragment that serves correctly while every landing page shows compiled links is a fragment nobody renders
a page that declares a swap loads the runtime that performs it; an hx-get with no htmx is inert decoration that renders the fallback forever and looks correct in the source

a landing surface is authored state, not a file under a site root; a file is a fine way to serve a page and a poor way to own one, and thirteen files each carrying their own navigation is what made a single nav change a thirteen-file edit
an authored page is served before the static file for the same route, so migration proceeds page by page and an unauthored route keeps working
a page declares its own title; an organ appending the institution name produced the institution named twice on the front page

an authored surface never displaces an existing machine contract: a territory root answers machines with its discovery descriptor, and adding a second machine view of one route is the drift this estate spends its effort preventing

a surface is not classified as a page or an application; it composes three layers over one addressed closure -- authored state, live closure lenses, and action apertures -- and the difference between a narrative page and an operating workspace is the balance among them, not a change of architecture

the authored layer holds copy and arrangement, the closure layer names patterns that render live addressed state, and the action layer names the subject whose admitted operations the surface offers; none of the three owns what another owns

the action layer is fetched rather than baked, because what a person may do depends on who they are and a page rendered for everyone cannot say; an anonymous reader is told operations exist and are not offered rather than shown a menu that lies

a surface renders at a requested extent -- chip, card, section, page or workspace -- and the extent changes how much of one closure is shown, never which subject is addressed; a workspace appearing elsewhere as a card is a projection rather than a second implementation
chip, card and section are fragments with no document chrome, because a surface embedded in another surface must not bring its own document
only a workspace carries the action layer; a page shows authored state and its closure without implying that anything may be done from it
an operation owned elsewhere posts to its owner; the aperture renders the form and the native organ performs the act, so no credential passes through the surface that drew it
a surface with one obvious action leads with that operation's form rather than a link to it; a list of one is a menu pretending to be a choice
a contract names the words on its own button and the type of its own fields; deriving them put the identifier open on a sign-in form and would have rendered a password as readable text
a native form works without a script runtime, so the owner accepts what a form posts; requiring JSON at that edge would make signing in depend on JavaScript
the action layer is carried at page and workspace and omitted below; a chip, card or section is a reference to a surface and there is no room to act inside a reference

authoring a route never removes a machine contract that route already had; the page declares machine_view deferred where a native owner answers machines, so the rule is a field rather than a route literal in the organ

an authored pane is rendered only to a caller who can fill it; htmx declares [45].. swap:false, so a fragment answering 401 leaves its placeholder on screen permanently and the page reports loading forever
a surface that withholds a pane for want of a session offers the operation that would grant one; withholding without offering is a dead end wearing the clothes of a loading state
a surface pattern reads a CMS type or a native organ, and the catalogue names which; a pattern that read an organ advertised itself as reading nothing while it worked
an organ a descriptor names is a bare bonfyre- identifier resolved inside the estate's own bin directory, never a path; content declares which organ is asked and can never choose what executes
a registry row whose fields are the descriptor's own field names is the header; testing for a literal column label was true of one organ's output and of nothing else
a panel carries its own title and caption, so every page composing it as a lens gets the same label and none of them can disagree about what the panel is
an organ that will not answer renders as a stated gap, never as an empty list; an empty panel reads as nothing to see, which is a different claim

an authored surface keeps its compiled route as a floor beneath it; the authored page declines when the CMS cannot be read, and without that floor a store outage turns a carrier surface into a 404 rather than into an older page

a client that sent a wildcard Accept is not a machine; representation follows what a client asked for, and treating the absence of an ask for HTML as an ask for JSON silently changes what every plain shell fetch has been reading

a static asset carries an ETag that is its own content digest and answers a conditional request with 304 and no body; no-cache without a validator is not caching, it is re-downloading with extra steps
an asset is reusable while it refreshes, so a deploy costs one stale view rather than a choice between speed and correctness

every authored page carries the institution's machine constellation in its head, so a reader who arrived at a page can reach the same institution's agent card, MCP descriptor, crate, field and federated identity; expecting foreign systems to be discoverable while publishing our own only where it happened to be emitted is a standard applied in one direction

speculation candidates come from the authored navigation, which is what this institution addresses, and never from a foreign origin or a relative href; a prefetch is a request made on the visitor's behalf and it must not be made to someone else's server
speculation eagerness is moderate, firing on intent rather than at load; prefetching the whole navigation on every page view spends a visitor's bandwidth to improve our own numbers
a below-fold panel declares content-visibility with an intrinsic size, so an expressive page stays cheap without a JavaScript virtualization layer and the scrollbar does not move under the reader

a pattern's declared authority distinguishes a session scope from an institutional grant: a bare word is a scope, and <institution>:<role> is a grant inside that estate, because a persona holding institutional write is not the same claim as a write-scoped session

a subject whose kind is a container for many things resolves its apertures against its classified kind; ForeignTwin covers a tax roll and a specification, and offering both the same operations would make the aperture list a statement about storage rather than about the thing
a role requirement is satisfied by a higher role and refused by a lower one in the same institution; a surface that admits every authenticated member of an estate is checking membership, not role
a descriptor that fails identifier validation renders nothing and says so; an unsafe pattern is refused rather than sanitized into an approximate surface

a public surface serves published rows only; status_filter defaults to published and a pattern that reads a type where status is not meaningful must declare 'any' explicitly, which the catalogue then shows
a pattern declares the row-level visibility flags its read type carries, so a type marking rows unpublished or guest-forbidden has those rows excluded by the surface rather than by the reader
the estate publishes its own read surfaces at /_surface/ with each pattern's read type, effect class and authority requirement; a machine discovers what is served rather than guessing pattern names
